data.name: Thang Online Global
data.detailed_description:
Are you a fan of old-school MMORPGs?

A legendary world is awakening… and you’ve been chosen to save it.

Thang Online Global is a fantasy MMORPG rooted in Eastern mythology, blending dynamic action combat, ancient lore, and nostalgic charm into one epic journey. Relive the golden era of online RPGs as you fight mutating monsters, explore forgotten ruins, and uncover the secrets of a land on the brink of collapse.

Ancient forces are rising. Only the chosen can stop them.

You awaken as one of the fabled brown-eyed warriors, bearing the spirit of the phoenix god Thang. In a continent torn between light and darkness, it’s up to you to unite the tribes, challenge corrupted gods, and restore balance to the world.

Choose your tribe. Master your fighting style.

  • Rian: Agile, deadly, and in tune with nature. Master of spears, daggers and throwing darts

  • Kanhoa: Balanced warriors wielding swords, shields, bows, and boomerangs.

  • On-Du Sham: Mystical shamans who command elemental forces and heal allies.

Transform. Adapt. Outsmart.

  • Shift your combat attributes in real-time with the dynamic Ki system.

  • Instantly switch between three equipped weapons to create your own combos.

  • Enemies can mutate or evolve after death, making each battle unpredictable.

Upgrade gear. Become legendary.

Refine your weapons and armor through a robust enhancement system.
Combine items, forge unique upgrades, and unlock legendary gear to boost your power and visual flair.
Your equipment grows with you, craft your own destiny.

A revamped classic experience

  • Nostalgic 2000s MMORPG atmosphere.

  • Simple, intuitive UI perfect for both veterans and newcomers.

  • Deep progression with loot, crafting, and gear refinement.

  • Epic PvE boss fights and structured PvP in dedicated arenas.

A living community with active support

Join a global player base united by nostalgia and passion. With weekly events, guild systems, player-run markets, and consistent updates, Thang Online offers a vibrant online world ready to be explored and conquered.

Key Features

  • Classic MMORPG with real-time action combat

  • Three unique classes with distinct playstyles

  • Weapon and armor refinement system

  • Monster mutation and strategic Ki transformation

  • Deep progression with loot, crafting, and PvP arenas

  • Mythology-rich Eastern fantasy world

  • Active support, frequent events, and a global community

data.short_description: Thang Online Global has been relaunched and will soon also arrive on Steam. With real-time combat, unique classes, and deep gear refinement, it brings back the magic of old-school RPGs. Embraced by a global community, this adventure continues to expand, reviving the classic MMORPG spirit.

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 2 MX
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
